newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Energy Equity plans A$48 mln expansion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Energy Equity plans A$48 mln expansion.

text.p: Gas explorer power generation developer Energy Equity Ltd said on Friday it planned a A$48 million expansion of its operations in regional Queensland, including a 50 percent increase in capacity at its Barcaldine gas power station.
The expansion of the Barcaldine plant's production from 37 megawatts to 55 megawatts through the addition of a steam turbine would cost A$21 million.
Energy Equity would also build a A$12 million-163 kilometre pipeline connecting its gasfield at Gilmore with the EPIC South West Queensland pipeline.
There would also be a A$15 million of Energy Equity's gasfield at ATP 549P, including the building of gas collecting and processing facilities.
Pipelines would be connected to the EPIC South West Queensland pipeline and the Australia Gas Light Mt Isa pipeline under construction.
The expansion would be funded from current cash resources and a recent A$120 million funding facility from the Commonwealth Bank of Australia .
Energy Equity said it continued to evaluate integrated gas and power projects and had further credit facilities for capital expenditure after this Queensland expansion was funded.

It said the Barcaldine power station's efficiency will be boosted 50 percent by adding the steam turbine without the need for any additional gas, and the expansion will be generating revenue in the second quarter of 1999.
Energy Equity's shares were up one cent at A$1.53 at 1.40 a.m. (0340 GMT).
